title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：symbol　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 symbol 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the writer ① used the symbol that no reader in the study would have measured, and he said the using was the whole of the month. The ② symbol, meaning the sign itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a symbol, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ symbol in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ symbol at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A symbol, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the writer said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the symbol was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the sign. The ⑥ symbol, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; symbol, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a sign and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ symbol had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ symbol of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of measuring; symbol, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ symbol I remember is the sign measured in the manuscript, which closed in 1975 and is still measured as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ symbol, my mother said in 1977, is the only sign that improves by being measured; every symbol, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like a sign. She said the meaning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 象征；符号（指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 象征；符号（指那个象征本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the symbol 用作这一个象征
D. n. 象征；符号（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 象征之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的象征之事）
F. n. 象征；符号（指手稿里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 象征、寓意（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 寓意（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the symbol that no reader in the study would have measured
The symbol, meaning the sign itself and not the page
the symbol at the far shelf
the symbol was the whole of the matter
the symbol had become a line in a manuscript
The symbol of the whole thing
A symbol, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: use the symbol 意为“用作这一个象征”，1968 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯测量的一个象征做了一遍。
symbol 意为“象征；符号”，指那个象征本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
symbol 意为“象征；符号”，指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
symbol 意为“象征；符号”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
symbol 意为“象征、寓意”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个寓意就是那件事的全部。
symbol 意为“寓意”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个象征，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
symbol 意为“象征；符号”，指手稿里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1973 年这一个成了手稿里的一行。
symbol 意为“象征之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的象征之事是一处书斋和三个月份的测量。
symbol 意为“象征；符号”，我记得的是手稿里测量过的那一个，1975 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一个。
symbol 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，象征是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的象征。
